description: This file contains test functions for the 'repositories' package, specifically testing database operations related to project differential data, such as inserting, retrieving recent diffs, and table management.

classes.name: e.MappedDiffTarget
classes.description: A struct representing a diff target with upstream and downstream target IDs.

classes.name: e.AnalyzedDiffRow
classes.description: A struct representing an analyzed diff row with details about code differences.

classes.name: e.DiffRow
classes.description: A struct representing a basic diff row with project information and change metrics.

methods.name: clearProjectTable
methods.description: Clears the project differential table in the database.

methods.name: getProjectRowCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of rows in the project differential table.

methods.name: TestInsertDiffRows
methods.description: Tests inserting diff rows into the database and verifies the row count.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the most recent outer key (timestamp and UUID) after inserting diff rows.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentOuterKeyEmpty
methods.description: Ensures proper error handling when retrieving the most recent outer key from an empty database.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentDifferentials
methods.description: Tests fetching the most recent differential records, considering date filtering and data correctness.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentDifferentialsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving recent differentials from an empty table returns empty results without error.
